ideas.title: Minnesota fraud cases on the rise
ideas.description: Investigate the recent surge in fraud cases in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future case and the Hortonville woman's FoodShare and child care fraud plot.
questions: What is causing the increase in fraud cases?
How can programs be protected from fraud?
ideas.insight: The recent sentencing and pleas in Minnesota fraud cases suggest a need for increased oversight and monitoring of programs to prevent fraud.
